laws.rule: Great Walk huts must be booked in advance on DOC's booking system; international visitors pay higher summer rates (October to April) and DOC staff run random checks at huts. Abel Tasman Coast Track: international adult NZD 84 a hut night in summer (about A$67.31, RBA rate of 30 October 2026); Heaphy Track NZD 66.

layers.process: Abel Tasman Coast Track: the 4 huts and 18 campsites must be booked in advance all year round. Arriving without a valid booking, or staying somewhere other than the site named on the ticket, can bring a penalty fee or a request to leave the park. Campsites are for tents, not hammocks, and campers may not use hut facilities. Dogs are not allowed. There is one compulsory tidal crossing.
